# Claw, phase 4: the game's parts from the gated model (run with --no-save after p3): the hub (hub,
# lamp, collar) with its origin at the collar's bottom centre (z 0.545); one prong (the back one,
# turned to +X) with its origin at its hinge; a long cable (3.5 m) with its origin at its foot.
# The game turns three copies of the prong round the hub and swings them open and shut.
# Generated by make_claw.py.
select Cable
delete
select Hub HubTop Lamp Collar
translate 0 0 -0.545
export claw_hub.glb --selection
delete
select ProngL ProngR
delete
select ProngB
set rotation 0 0 -90
apply --rotation
translate -0.15 0 -0.56
export claw_prong.glb --selection
delete
add mesh cylinder --name Cable --vertices 6 --radius 0.035 --depth 3.5 --location 0 0 1.75
material assign Cable
active Cable
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export claw_cable.glb --selection
